summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure, resolve all PR review comments, then fix a critical architectural bug where the vault IPFS key blob and root folder metadata shared the same IPNS name.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 gap closure executed and verified (9/9 truths), PR #344 merged after 5 rounds of review resolution, and PR #349 created to fix vault key IPNS separation with updated metadata documentation.

repo: The vault v2 blob format is exclusively for the root vault key blob (wraps ECIES-encrypted rootFolderKey). All folder metadata — including root folder updates after init — uses v1 JSON format ({iv, data}). These are two distinct IPNS names now.
IPNS names are derived via HKDF with different info strings: 'cipherbox-vault-ipns-v1' for root folder metadata, 'cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1' for the vault key blob.
TypeORM auto-discovers migrations from the migrations/ directory glob — no explicit imports needed. Migrations can be consolidated directly into FullSchema when DB is being reset.
The GSD workflow commits planning docs automatically via gsd-tools.cjs — double-committing from the orchestrator is a no-op but wastes a step.
CodeRabbit consistently misunderstood the v1/v2 blob scope across 4+ review rounds — this was a documentation gap, not a code issue.
orval regenerates api-client index.ts but does not delete stale model files — orphaned .ts files must be manually removed after schema changes.
The GSD --gaps-only flag reads VERIFICATION.md and skips research, creating gap_closure plans. These are executed with --gaps-only on execute-phase.

code.finding: Added deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair with info 'cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1' alongside existing deriveVaultIpnsKeypair ('cipherbox-vault-ipns-v1')
Login reads rootFolderKey from vault key IPNS (new derivation). New user init publishes v2 blob to vault key IPNS and v1 metadata to root folder IPNS separately.
Critical bug fixed: /vault/init API call must happen AFTER IPFS upload + IPNS publish, not before. If IPFS fails, backend would have a vault row with no blob.
Removed encrypt_root_metadata_to_v2_blob function — root folder now uses encrypt_metadata_to_json like all other folders.
fetchWithTimeout using AbortController — .finally(clearTimeout) was incorrect as it cleared the timer before body reads complete. Timer should only be cleared on success/error after full response.
rootIpnsName validated against ^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$ before innerHTML use. escapeHtml helper added for exportedAt and derivationInfo.
Zero-length key_len must be rejected in both serialize AND deserialize. Copilot caught that only deserialize had the check initially.
Rust serialize + deserialize both needed zero-length key rejection to match TypeScript behavior.
SDK E2E test helper was sending encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey in vault init — NestJS whitelist validation rejects unknown properties, causing 400 errors.
FullSchema was creating vaults table with crypto columns that were then added/dropped by two subsequent migrations. Net schema is columns-never-exist — consolidate into FullSchema when resetting DB.

workflow: When a DB reset is planned, consolidate add-then-drop migration pairs directly into the initial schema migration to eliminate dead migration round trips.
GitHub outside-diff review comments appear in the review body, not as resolvable threads — reply to the review body and fix the code, but cannot resolve via GraphQL thread resolution.
After merging a branch, todos must be committed on a fresh branch off main — the todo file written on the merged branch is not present on main.
Monitoring for incoming CodeRabbit reviews: poll unresolved thread count every 30s after pushing fixes.

The GSD gap closure cycle: verify-work creates gaps in VERIFICATION.md → plan-phase --gaps reads gaps and creates gap_closure plans → execute-phase --gaps-only runs only those plans → verifier re-runs.

friction: Todo was committed to the already-merged branch (phase-20-vault-migration) instead of main — required stash, branch switch, and file recreation.
orval regeneration does not clean up orphaned model files — required manual deletion of 4 stale .ts files after DropVaultCryptoColumns removed the DTO types.
pnpm build order dependency: packages/crypto must be built before apps/web — building web directly after editing crypto source fails with type errors.
The vault key IPNS separation bug was not caught during Phase 20 execution or verification — only surfaced as a code review discussion point after merge.
SDK E2E tests sending old crypto fields caused a CI failure that required a separate fix commit after the PR was already approved.
METADATA_SCHEMAS.md commit failed on first attempt due to a stale internal anchor link (#14-ipns-key-derivation) that needed updating.
open_items: PR #349 (fix/vault-key-ipns-separation) needs review and merge before vault migration can be released to staging — E2E tests are currently failing due to this bug.
Two items in VERIFICATION.md require human verification in a live environment: new user v2 blob publish order (IPFS before API registration) and recovery tool IPFS-direct path with real vault.
Phase 23 is next in the roadmap — /gsd:discuss-phase 23 before planning.
The PR description was updated to reflect final state but Windows cargo check was still running at end of session — confirm it passed before treating phase as fully closed.
